display_name: 无标签信号库频谱门控的源域训练
description: 对输入相位时移锚点与无标签地面源 IQ 信号库形成的多邻域参考，用轻量复数频谱门控预测单次 IQ 修复；DURA 仅在源域筛选对照。

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; 8192 disjoint source clean IQ dictionary, 16 input-correlated complex gain-aligned neighbors; no class metadata
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels or U_s truth read; frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL predictions guide source training

permissions.query_use: Source-only training and candidate selection; no V, test IQ, Phase3; no automatic test predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed, source heldout and Phase1 development previously observed, no independent-blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Random spectral gate; fixed source phase factor and gate; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL. DURA only loaded after training for source evaluation.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned r02 source dependency 284317bd819df974395d3388b1920a41300937cb; fixed phase checkpoint SHA256 8e9fd8f97a57263be320b8dd57e4dd615fb015d5aab2d276d43864ec8fe8e508
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Source RX4/6 cache19 vs DURA: per-cell F pseudo-target decrease <= max(1,ceil(.5% valid)), clean IQ <= DURA+.001, impaired IQ <=1.2*DURA+1e-6, aggregate impaired pseudo-correct net >=10; epochs1/2/3 alpha .5/1 threshold .8/.99; RX8 heldout not used

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Source F pseudo-target agreement is not ground truth or 3% goal; selected network needs separately fixed inference and full Phase1 test.

rows.method: label-free source dictionary top16 phase-aligned average, complex frequency residual gate, frozen input protection and phase
rows.purpose: test source improvement and preservation vs DURA before any Phase1 test
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source split 2026110551, model 2026112554, dictionary sample and train shuffle 2026112555; caches11–13 train,19 source eval
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Dictionary and training/validation/holdout physical IDs are mutually disjoint; source IDs appeared in earlier channel views, no blind claim.
Dictionary can inject foreign transmitter fingerprints; classification and IQ guarded independently.
Phase factor previously trained from DURA source teacher; network inference does not call DURA.
DURA loaded only after all three checkpoints fixed; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or test IQ.
Pilot 64 updates: 251 valid source pseudo targets, spectral 211, raw 213, DURA 240; no target result.
